parameters.query: =WITH payload AS (SELECT '{{$json.body_sql}}'::jsonb AS body), msg AS (INSERT INTO job_messages (job_id,sender_type,sender_id,message_type,message_text,attachments) SELECT NULLIF(body->>'job_id','')::uuid,'agent',NULLIF(body->>'sender_id',''),'revision_request',COALESCE(body->>'revision_notes',body->>'message_text','Revision requested'),COALESCE(body->'attachments','[]'::jsonb) FROM payload RETURNING id,job_id), task AS (INSERT INTO content_tasks (job_id,task_type,task_key,status,input_payload) SELECT job_id,'revision','revision_'||id::text,'queued',(SELECT body FROM payload) FROM msg RETURNING id), event_insert AS (INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata) SELECT job_id,'revision_requested','Revision requested',jsonb_build_object('message_id',(SELECT id FROM msg),'task_id',(SELECT id FROM task)) FROM msg) SELECT (SELECT id::text FROM msg) AS message_id,(SELECT id::text FROM task) AS task_id;
